notes: No release before 0.5.0 may claim any of this is balanced. Every magnitude in the shipped content carries tuningStatus untuned and the balance harness owns all of them, so this file is a measurement and not a balance claim. The universe remains degenerate in known ways and this change closes none of them: these gate sweeps are 100 percent passive-control and submit no god verb, teaching still dies out once the founding grants are taught (a researched instance starts at fp(256) against a teach threshold of fp(512)), scribing still stops when the materials stock empties around world year seventy, and no raid runs in any sweep because nothing in packages/scenario opens a portal yet. What this change does is remove one confound from the knowledge side: before it, two code paths priced the same work differently, so any measurement of how expensive rediscovery is was reading an artefact of which path asked.
rationale: researchFrontier priced rediscovery on wasEverKnown alone, so every node the universe currently holds was quoted at the >=3x rediscovery price while research() charged the ordinary one. It now calls isRediscovery -- wasEverKnown AND NOT exists -- the same predicate the charge uses. No constant, cap, magnitude or content value changed; one predicate did. The direction is uniform and is the mechanism: a quote that no longer inflates the price of nodes the universe already holds means more research is attempted and completed, so knowledge accumulates faster. Twenty world years over 200 runs, the gate that failed: referenceKnowledgeInstances 1036.95 to 1084.96 (+48.01, 4.96 SE against a tolerance of 29.03), referenceLibraryDepth 25.36 to 25.88 (+0.73 SE), referenceGrimoires 391.655 to 388.385 (-0.37 SE), referenceLivingMages 37.60 to 37.71 (+0.59 SE), referenceNodesKnown 46.855 to 47.015 (+1.34 SE). referenceKnowledgeInstances was the only metric outside 3 SE on any of the three horizons. Five world years over 200 runs passed unchanged in shape, largest move referenceKnowledgeInstances 406.010 to 404.750 (-0.43 SE). Two hundred world years over 32 runs passed: instances 1942.13 to 2091.63, grimoires 110.125 to 120.594, library depth 24.9375 to 26.9063, living mages 70.4063 to 72.0313, nodes known 65.4688 to 61.8438.
